requestedDecisions.closeTotality: Sound. Every reported terminal operation produces StoppedSession and closes there, including refusal/abort helpers, four preparation error families, three publication outcome families, and A-phase refused()/undetermined(). Successful preparation and other continuing results remain open. Close is attached to the producer, not repeated at wrapper returns.
requestedDecisions.panicDrop: Sound. Dropping PreparedCommit creates no reported terminal outcome or StoppedSession. Its surviving latch can alter only memory; private, non-Clone, consuming ownership prevents any later permit/publication through the dropped value. X3D:213 assigns omitted finish to recovery evidence, with no cleanup/commit success claim.
requestedDecisions.gateState: Monotonic opening/closing bits, masked logical-state reads, full-word-preserving CAS loops and one atomic order preserve the logical 0..3 law and F41 without a reset or second gate. These remain S10/S11/J3b implementation obligations.
requestedDecisions.row44Aggregate: Sound as a render-step route followed by WS:233-240 aggregation. A render operational fault dominates earlier rejection. When both steps are operational-failed, the first termination carrying domain detail wins in step order, or the first when neither carries detail. Row 44 therefore does not unconditionally replace an earlier detailed operational fault.
requestedDecisions.uncertainIdentity: Preserving the actual uncertain analysis ExecutionId and namespace is lawful under the X3D/X7 fault owners and existing carrier. It remains additional recovery disclosure if aggregation selects a renderer primary fault. It is not the render attempt id, a caller id or evidence of a committed Run; no in-invocation recovery occurs. The verdict-composition citation needs the NB-01 ownership clarification.
requestedDecisions.s18Gate: Consistent across 5.3, item 6, 8.2, 8.4, S18 and item 14. No durable or ephemeral O output is wired before separate S18 acceptance. Pure models and non-output work may proceed. After acceptance, ephemeral uses A/O/E with no RunId or durable effect, and actual required-step terminality defines E.
requestedDecisions.outputFailures: Evidence-dependent before-byte failure projection, exit 4 with no replacement on an escaped/uncertain-prefix write failure, and one coded line if the failure envelope cannot be rendered are sound. No repeated envelope attempt or durability retry is authorized.
requestedDecisions.amendmentScope: The 18 diff hunks stay within the three r2 corrections, adopted non-blocking recording note, associated controls/gates and review records. Other r1/r2 decisions and closures remain intact.
